name: 3M Filtek Supreme Flowable Restorative
description: The 3M™ Filtek™ Supreme Flowable Restorative offers long-lasting wear resistance and polish retention. It is designed for a wide range of indications and techniques, including class I-V and injection molding. This versatile composite resin lets you create dental restorations that meet the highest expectations with a range of 12 shades formulated to be an exact match to 3M™Filtek™ Universal Restoratives' and 3M™ Filtek™ Supreme Ultra Universal Restoratives’ body shades. Upgraded syringe creates virtually no bubbles or material “run-on”. Bendable cannula improves access to deep restorations. Ergonomic design is easy to hold and requires less effort to inject. Made with 3M’s TRUE nanotechnology for excellent polish retention and wear resistance. Available in a wide variety of shades to match the VITA Classical Shade Guide and body shades of 3M™ Filtek™ Supreme Ultra Universal Restorative for natural-looking esthetics. Can be warmed up to 70°C/158°F for up to 1 hour, up to 25 times. Complete your premium restoration using the gold standard of adhesion with 3M Scotchbond Universal Plus Adhesive . Monitors 250°F (121°C) 30-minute gravity and 15-, 20-, 30- or 35-minute dynamic-air-removal (pre-vacuum and SFPP) saturated steam sterilization processes. Compatible with the 3M™ Attest™ Auto-reader 490 or 3M™ Attest™ Mini Auto-reader 490M. UDI-compliant 2-D barcode technology to capture BI GTIN, use-by date and lot code with handheld scanner. name: Kerr Traverse Rotary Glide Path File
description: Introducing the Traverse rotary glide path file. Over 125 years ago, Kerr invented the K-file and now we unveil the latest, state-of-the-art file technology — Traverse. Simplifying the procedure, Traverse inspires confidence and optimal results. Use to establish a smooth and reproducible glide path. Available in Length (mm) 21, 25, 31; Tip sizes (mm) 0.13, 0.18; Taper 0.06. For your convenience an orifice opener is also available in Length (mm) 17, Tip size (mm) 0.25, and Taper 0.08. Resistance To Stress / Deformation / Breakage -- Unique “Variable Heat Treatment” technology offers enhanced resistance to torsional stress and breakage compared to other glide path files on the market*. Simplified Procedure / Reduced Chair Time -- Compared to traditional hand files, Traverse requires fewer instruments to establish the glide path, which improves efficiency and reduces chair time*. Superior Rotary Glide Path -- Traverse rotary glide path technology enhances your technique by creating a more tapered glide path that reduces the workload on subsequent shaping files when compared with .02 taper rotary glide path files*. Overcome Calcifications and Difficult Anatomy -- A triangular cross-section and rotary motion are highly efficient at overcoming canal impediments. Maximum Flute Diameter -- With a maximum flute diameter of just 1mm, Traverse preserves more natural tooth structure than continuous or progressively tapered files. Non-Cutting Tip for Enhanced Control -- Minimizes the chance for ledging or perforation of the canal. Optimized torsional strength makes files less likely to separate and provides greater control.

name: Pola Rapid

Potassium nitrate, the key pain reducing ingredient, prevents sensitivity to provide a calming effect. The high water content of Pola Rapid ensures maximum comfort during and after treatment. The shorter treatment time results in less patient discomfort and lower sensitivity. Pola Rapid uses an advanced blue gel for ease of visibility and application. The easy to apply non-stick gel enables faster application and removal. Available with and without Optragate, an extra soft disposable lip and cheek retractor. which gently and evenly retracts to provide a full view of the anterior and posterior teeth. * Data available from SDI.

name: TurboSensor+360 Ultrasonic Scaler
description: The TurboSensor+360 Ultrasonic Scaler is engineered to meet the demands of modern dental practices by combining precision scaling performance with advanced workflow efficiency. Designed for hygienists and clinicians, this ultrasonic scaler delivers consistent power output to effectively remove calculus, plaque, and biofilm during routine and periodontal procedures. Featuring Cruise Control technology, the TurboSensor+360 allows for continuous scaling without constant foot pedal pressure, reducing clinician fatigue and improving ergonomics during extended procedures. This hands-free functionality enhances workflow efficiency while maintaining consistent performance throughout treatment. With universal compatibility for all major 30K inserts—and optional support for 25K inserts—this unit allows practices to use existing instruments without disruption. Its advanced waterline protection system includes multi-stage filtration to reduce contaminants and support infection control protocols. The detachable, autoclavable handpiece and easy-to-maintain components simplify sterilization and reduce downtime, making the TurboSensor+360 a reliable, high-performance solution for high-volume hygiene environments. Key Features Cruise Control Technology – Enables hands-free scaling to reduce clinician fatigue Universal Insert Compatibility – Works with all major 30K inserts (25K optional) Consistent Power Output – Ensures effective removal of calculus and biofilm Advanced Waterline Protection – Multi-stage filtration supports infection control Autoclavable Handpiece – Detachable design for efficient sterilization Ergonomic Workflow Design – Improves comfort during extended procedures Smart Operating Modes – Includes purge and priming functions for efficiency Product Specifications Brand: Parkell Product Type: Ultrasonic Scaler Unit Frequency: 30 kHz (25K compatible with optional handpiece) Technology: Cruise Control scaling mode Insert Compatibility: Universal (all major brands) Handpiece: Detachable, autoclavable Waterline System: Multi-stage filtration Application: Supragingival and subgingival scaling Use Case: Hygiene operatories, periodontal procedures Clinical Uses Removal of supragingival and subgingival calculus Routine dental prophylaxis and hygiene procedures Periodontal maintenance and scaling Biofilm disruption and plaque removal High-efficiency hygiene workflows in busy practices Frequently Asked Questions What makes the TurboSensor+360 different from other scalers? It features Cruise Control technology for hands-free scaling, universal insert compatibility, and advanced waterline protection. Is it compatible with other brands of inserts? Yes, it works with all major 30K inserts and can support 25K inserts with an optional handpiece. How does Cruise Control improve workflow? It reduces the need for constant pedal pressure, minimizing fatigue and improving clinician ergonomics. Is the handpiece autoclavable? Yes, the detachable handpiece is fully autoclavable for infection control compliance. What type of practices is this best for? It is ideal for high-volume hygiene practices seeking efficiency, reliability, and ease of maintenance.
